prompts.text: Find as many matching pairs as you can.
Click one box then find the different box whose contents matches and click it.
For each correct match you get 10 points added to your score.
For each incorrect match 2 points are subtracted from your score.
Correct answers will reveal a picture and music.
When you are ready to play, choose a level and then click Start to begin
If you want to see the directions again after the game has started, click Repeat Directions.
